note: Fuzzer bytes are copied into a subtitle buffer and parsed as ASS input.
The raw input is NUL-terminated and handed to the parser.
Subtitle events are parsed from the attacker-controlled buffer.
Each parsed event is rendered at a timestamp derived from the parsed timing fields.
Rendering uses the parsed subtitle text, which can drive hash-table lookups for cached outline/glyph data.
String-valued cache keys are hashed directly from their buffer pointer and length.

code: static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)
note: When a zero-length string reaches the hash helper, the do/while loop still dereferences the buffer and crashes because empty strings are not handled.
